name: 5'-nucleotidase, cytosolic II

function.text: NT5C2 encodes cytosolic purine 5'-nucleotidase. Annotated molecular activities include 5'-deoxynucleotidase activity and 5'-nucleotidase activity. It participates in GMP metabolic process and IMP catabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex hereditary spastic paraplegia (autosomal recessive); hereditary spastic paraplegia 45 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
